Ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha, tek "Lion Residence 2", shitet apartament 1+1.

Distanca prej 1.4 km nga qendra e kryeqytetit e bën këtë projekt një investim koherent dhe vizionar. description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, at "Lion Residence 2", a 1+1 apartment is for sale. Lion Park 2 is an innovative and elite project positioned at a strategic point with immediate access to all the main areas of Tirana. The distance of 1.4 km from the center of the capital makes this project a coherent and visionary investment. Also, the infrastructure, facilities, surrounding institutions and other similar investments in the area are obvious indicators that the whole area is undergoing rapid development. Information about the apartment: • Gross area: 82.26 m2 • Net area: 68.55m2. • Floor 14 Organization: • Living room • Kitchen room • Bedroom • Toilets • Balcony • Section A The building is expected to be completed within the year 2029.
